name: Sunbelle Adventures
summary: Marketing and booking site for curated, private luxury safaris across Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda & Tanzania.

case_study.intro: A marketing and booking site for a luxury safari company running curated, private trips across Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda and Tanzania.
case_study.challenge: Sunbelle sells curated, private safaris at the premium end of the market. The website had to feel as considered as the trips themselves, present four countries without overwhelming visitors, and make it easy for a serious buyer to start a conversation.
case_study.solution: We built a custom-coded marketing and booking site that leads with itineraries and imagery, organizes trips by destination, and routes every inquiry straight to the Sunbelle team.

features.title: Itinerary pages
features.text: Each trip is laid out day by day so a buyer can picture the journey before they enquire.

features.title: Destination structure
features.text: Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda and Tanzania each have a clear home, so visitors find the right trips quickly.

features.title: Direct inquiry path
features.text: Booking-request forms put serious buyers in touch with the team without extra steps.

outcomes: A site that matches the premium feel of the brand
A clear structure across four destinations
A direct route from itinerary to inquiry
Custom-coded and mobile-friendly, with no template

name: Pembe Beyond Plains
summary: Booking site for a Nairobi safari outfitter, with destination guides, package pages, and a get-a-quote flow across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda & Rwanda.

case_study.intro: A booking site for a Nairobi safari outfitter, with destination guides, package pages and a get-a-quote flow across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and Rwanda.
case_study.challenge: Safari buyers research destinations first and compare operators second. Pembe Beyond Plains needed a site that helps people explore four countries, understand each package, and ask for a quote without friction.
case_study.solution: We built a booking site around the way buyers decide: destination guides for inspiration, package pages for detail, and a get-a-quote flow that is available from every page.
solution_points: Destination guides for Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and Rwanda
A get-a-quote flow from any page

features.title: Destination guides
features.text: Each country gets its own guide, so visitors can explore before they commit to a trip.

features.title: Package pages
features.text: Every package has its own page with the detail a buyer needs to compare options.

features.title: Get-a-quote flow
features.text: A short quote request keeps the step from interest to enquiry as small as possible.

outcomes: Four destinations organized into clear guides
Package pages that are easy to compare
A quote request reachable from every page
Custom-coded and mobile-friendly, with no template

name: Mindrift AI Trainers
summary: Job board connecting careful readers and editors with paid, remote AI-training review roles — free skills-check screening, hourly pay, no portfolio required.

case_study.intro: A job board connecting careful readers and editors with paid, remote AI-training review roles. Applicants take a free skills check, are paid by the hour, and need no portfolio.
case_study.challenge: Review work depends on attention to detail, and marking every applicant's test by hand does not scale. The site needed a free skills check that grades itself, listings people can trust, and payments that work for Kenyan users.
case_study.solution: We built the site in Node.js and Express with server-rendered pages, paired it with a separate Python and Flask service that grades the skills check, and integrated M-Pesa Daraja and Paystack for payments.

features.title: Skills-check screening
features.text: Applicants complete a free check that a Flask service grades without manual marking.

features.title: Role listings
features.text: Remote, hourly-paid review roles presented clearly, with no portfolio needed to apply.

features.title: Local payments
features.text: M-Pesa Daraja and Paystack are both integrated, so users can pay the way they prefer.

outcomes: Automated grading in a dedicated Python service
Built and deployed end to end on Kenyan hosting
